summary: Fathom Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose two material definitive agreements: an amended and restated bridge note with Bed Bath & Beyond Inc., increasing the original principal by $1,000,000 to $3,036,350 (including $36,350 accrued interest), and a limited waiver and omnibus amendment with holders of its senior secured convertible promissory notes waiving existing defaults related to late filing of its Q1 2026 Form 10-Q. These are debt modifications and default waivers, not a special situation transaction. The amendments involve no change of control, buyout, or corporate restructuring. No deal terms, premium, or close date apply. Monitor compliance with filing requirements and note conversion mechanics.
